# 1 Enoch Chapter 88 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Dreams — Animal Apocalypse

---

**88:1** And one of those four white ones came to me and took me by my hand and raised me up and set me down on the side of those sheep, far from them; and he gave me a sword.

**88:2** And I saw the abyss opened in the midst of the earth, full of fire, and they brought those blind sheep, and they were all judged and found guilty and cast into this fiery abyss, and they burned.

**88:3** Now that abyss was to the right of that house.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering adjudicated from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA.*

**ANIMAL APOCALYPSE — SYMBOLISM KEY (Chapter 88):**
- **White one** (v. 1) = archangel (one of the four from ch. 87)
- **Sheep** (v. 1) = the righteous/elect (Enoch is now placed among the sheep — the allegory shifts from bulls/oxen to sheep for the elected people)
- **Sword given to Enoch** (v. 1) = his authority as witness; possibly prophetic authority
- **Blind sheep thrown into fiery abyss** (v. 2) = the fallen Watchers facing final judgment
- **Fiery abyss** = the place of punishment (cf. Gehenna imagery; also 1 En 10:6; 18:11-16)
- **'That house'** (v. 3) = the heavenly dwelling (cf. ch. 14); the judgment pit is adjacent to God's throne

*Chapter 88 is the transition between the Watcher punishment and the Noah/flood narrative of chapter 89.*
